scope_note: This describes the predecessor cathartic procedure in Freud's historical account, not every technique used anywhere in the 1895 case histories.
statement: Freud's 1904 description said the cathartic method presupposed that the patient could be hypnotized.
statement_zh: Freud 在 1904 年的描述中指出，宣洩法預設病人能夠被催眠。
